scope: Agreement with draft, potentially incomplete annotations; not official challenge scoring or expert-validated accuracy. Unmatched predictions require review, not automatic false-positive labels.

plan.ranking: draft F1, then recall, then fewer changed settings, then configuration ID
plan.synthetic_guard: development F1 and recall must not fall below the detector default

note: Trial changed_parameters are applied to the fully resolved defaults stored here. No historical model default was replaced.

holdout.scope: Fresh synthetic validation of frozen defaults/winners; not clinical accuracy.

runtime_smoke_check.scope: No real truth; counts are not accuracy. Four logical CPUs; timings exclude imports and output. Peak memory is for refined, including its nested source detectors.
